signal: Placer.ai integrated its foot-traffic data into Green Street's US platform in March 2026, on top of a $75M Series D.

email.body1:
Liam, saw Placer pushed its foot-traffic data into Green Street's US platform on the back of the $75M Series D.

Growth like that floods the pipeline with new accounts, and SDR follow-up volume becomes the bottleneck long before headcount can catch up. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so reps stop drowning in lists: 3-5x more meetings per rep, same team.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to top accounts off your latest signals. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Liam, quick follow-up for Placer.

With expansion in flight, response speed makes or breaks the quarter, and ramp time rarely keeps pace with the volume. The fix is usually less about more people and more about faster, tighter touches across email and LinkedIn.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70 percent, and I'll show where Placer's gaps likely sit.
email.body3:
Liam, last bit of proof for Placer.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Placer's reply rate likely compares to similar teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Liam, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If easing your follow-up load isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Expansion mode is its own kind of busy, and timing matters most here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an SDR team? I'll tailor it to Placer either way.
